import predicates = "./predicates.qui"
import triangulation = "./triangulation.qui"
import voronoi = "./voronoi.qui"
import proximity = "./proximity.qui"
import plot = "./plot.qui"

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

string real_text(real64 value)
    result := "{value:.3}"
    return if result == "-0.000" then "0.000" else result

string words(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return fields.join(" ")

string yes_no(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

string optional_id(int value)
    return if value == 0 then "-" else "{value}"

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    result := content.split(NL)
    return result[0:<int(#result) - 1]

bool integer_word(string value)
    int[] codes := value.codepoints()
    start := if #codes > 0 and codes[0] == 45 then 1 else 0
    if int(#codes) == start
        return false
    for: start <= i < int(#codes)
        if codes[i] < 48 or codes[i] > 57
            return false
    return true

int integer_value(string value)
    int[] codes := value.codepoints()
    start := if codes[0] == 45 then 1 else 0
    result := 0
    for: start <= i < int(#codes)
        result = result * 10 + codes[i] - 48
    return if start == 1 then -result else result

class Input(int[][] points, int line_count, string[] rejected)
class Params(int plot_width, int plot_height, string[] plot_layers, string[] sections, int[] alpha, string[] queries)

Input read_points()
    lines := read_lines("input/points.txt")
    int[][] points := []
    string[] rejected := []
    for: i < int(#lines)
        line := lines[i]
        if #line == 0 or line[0] == "#"
            continue
        fields := line.split(" ")
        if #fields != 2 or not integer_word(fields[0]) or not integer_word(fields[1])
            rejected = rejected.append("reject {i + 1} format")
            continue
        x := integer_value(fields[0])
        y := integer_value(fields[1])
        if x < 0 or x > 1000 or y < 0 or y > 1000
            rejected = rejected.append("reject {i + 1} range")
            continue
        duplicate := 0
        for: site < int(#points)
            if points[site][0] == x and points[site][1] == y
                duplicate = site + 1
                break
        if duplicate > 0
            rejected = rejected.append("reject {i + 1} duplicate {duplicate}")
        else
            points = points.append([x, y])
    return Input(points, int(#lines), rejected)

Params read_params()
    width := 61
    height := 31
    layers := ["edges", "hull", "sites"]
    sections := ["summary"]
    int[] alpha := []
    string[] queries := []
    for line := read_lines("input/params.txt")[]
        if #line == 0 or line[0] == "#"
            continue
        fields := line.split(" ")
        name := fields[0]
        values := fields[1:<int(#fields)]
        if name == "plot"
            width = integer_value(values[0])
            height = integer_value(values[1])
        elif name == "plot_layers"
            layers = values
        elif name == "sections"
            sections = values
        elif name == "alpha"
            alpha = [for value := values[] then integer_value(value)]
        else
            queries = queries.append(line[6:<int(#line)])
    return Params(width, height, layers, sections, alpha, queries)

real64 arctangent(real64 value)
    negative := value < 0.0
    reduced := if negative then -value else value
    reciprocal := reduced > 1.0
    if reciprocal
        reduced = 1.0 / reduced
    real64 offset := 0.0
    if reduced > 0.4142135623730950488
        reduced = (reduced - 1.0) / (reduced + 1.0)
        offset = 0.7853981633974483096
    term := reduced
    real64 total := 0.0
    for: i < 40
        total += term / as_real(2 * i + 1)
        term *= -reduced * reduced
    total += offset
    if reciprocal
        total = 1.5707963267948966192 - total
    return if negative then -total else total

real64 angle2(real64 vertical, real64 horizontal)
    if horizontal > 0.0
        return arctangent(vertical / horizontal)
    if horizontal < 0.0
        result := arctangent(vertical / horizontal)
        return if vertical >= 0.0 then result + 3.141592653589793 else result - 3.141592653589793
    return if vertical > 0.0 then 1.5707963267948966192 elif vertical < 0.0 then -1.5707963267948966192 else 0.0

int[] circle_basis(int[][] points, int[] basis)
    if #basis == 3 and predicates.orient(points[basis[0] - 1], points[basis[1] - 1], points[basis[2] - 1]) < 0
        temporary := basis[1]
        basis[1] = basis[2]
        basis[2] = temporary
    return basis

int circle_value(int[][] points, int[] basis, int[] point)
    if #basis == 1
        return -predicates.d2(points[basis[0] - 1], point)
    if #basis == 2
        return -predicates.dot(point, points[basis[0] - 1], points[basis[1] - 1])
    return predicates.incircle(points[basis[0] - 1], points[basis[1] - 1], points[basis[2] - 1], point)

int[] convex_hull(int[][] points, int[] sites)
    if #sites <= 2
        return sites.sorted()
    int[] ordered := []
    for site := sites[]
        place := int(#ordered)
        for: k < int(#ordered)
            other := ordered[k]
            if points[site - 1][0] < points[other - 1][0] or points[site - 1][0] == points[other - 1][0] and points[site - 1][1] < points[other - 1][1]
                place = k
                break
        ordered = ordered[0:<place].append(site).concat(ordered[place:<int(#ordered)])
    int[] lower := []
    for site := ordered[]
        while #lower >= 2 and predicates.orient(points[lower[-2] - 1], points[lower[-1] - 1], points[site - 1]) <= 0
            lower = lower[0:<int(#lower) - 1]
        lower = lower.append(site)
    int[] upper := []
    for site := ordered[::-1][]
        while #upper >= 2 and predicates.orient(points[upper[-2] - 1], points[upper[-1] - 1], points[site - 1]) <= 0
            upper = upper[0:<int(#upper) - 1]
        upper = upper.append(site)
    int[] hull := lower[0:<int(#lower) - 1].concat(upper[0:<int(#upper) - 1])
    start := 0
    for: 1 <= i < int(#hull)
        if hull[i] < hull[start]
            start = i
    return hull[start:<int(#hull)].concat(hull[0:<start])

class Cell(int[] vertices, real64 clipped, bool bounded, real64 area, int[] incoming, int[] outgoing)
class AlphaResult(int alpha, int faces, int edges, int boundary, int dangling, int isolated, int components, int holes, int area2)

class Report self(int[][] points, int line_count, string[] rejected, Params params)
    n := int(#points)
    triangulation.Mesh mesh := triangulation.new_mesh(points)
    triangulation.Insertion[] insertions := []
    int[][] triangles := []
    int[][] directed := []
    int[][] edge_triangles := []
    int[][] edge_index := []
    int[][] edges := []
    int[] length2 := []
    hull_next := array(#points, fill = 0)
    hull_prev := array(#points, fill = 0)
    int[] hull := []
    int[][] hull_edges := []
    real64 hull_perimeter := 0.0
    hull_area2 := 0
    int[][] neighbors := []
    int[] degree := []
    int[] area2 := []
    string[] kinds := []
    kind_counts := [0, 0, 0]
    real64[] min_angles := []
    real64[] max_angles := []
    angle_bins := array(6, fill = 0)
    real64 min_angle_total := 0.0
    minimum_triangle := 0
    maximum_triangle := 0
    int[][] centers := []
    real64[] radius2 := []
    string[] positions := []
    position_counts := [0, 0, 0]
    string[] duals := []
    int[] empty_candidates := []
    empty_vertex := 0
    Cell[] cells := []
    real64 cell_total := 0.0
    real64 clip_total := 0.0
    largest_cell := 0
    int[] nearest_sites := []
    int[][] mutual_pairs := []
    closest := 0
    int[][] components := []
    component_number := array(#points, fill = 0)
    int[][] component_pairs := []
    int[][] mst := []
    bool[] mst_set := []
    bool[] gabriel := []
    bool[] rng := []
    gabriel_count := 0
    rng_count := 0
    gg_degree := array(#points, fill = 0)
    rng_degree := array(#points, fill = 0)
    mst_degree := array(#points, fill = 0)
    real64 mst_length := 0.0
    diameter := [1, 2]
    diameter2 := 0
    real64 width_value := inf
    int[] width_edge := []
    int[] enclosing_center := []
    real64 enclosing_radius2 := 0.0
    int[] enclosing_sites := []
    int[][] layers := []
    depth := array(#points, fill = 0)
    real64[][] path_distances := [for point := points[] then []]
    int[][] path_previous := [for point := points[] then []]
    pair_count := 0
    real64 maximum_stretch := 0.0
    int[] stretch_pair := []
    real64 stretch_length := 0.0
    real64 stretch_distance := 0.0
    real64 mean_stretch := 0.0
    AlphaResult[] alpha_results := []
    string[] answers := []
    string[] delaunay_plot := []
    string[] voronoi_plot := []

    void .build()
        for: 4 <= site <= n
            insertions = insertions.append(.mesh.insert(site))
        triangles = mesh.triangles()
        for: 1 <= u <= n
            directed = directed.append([for v := (1:n)[] then mesh.remaining(u, v)])
            edge_triangles = edge_triangles.append(array(nat(n), fill = 0))
            edge_index = edge_index.append(array(nat(n), fill = 0))
        for: k < int(#triangles)
            triangle := triangles[k]
            for: side < 3
                edge_triangles[triangle[side] - 1][triangle[(side + 1) % 3] - 1] = k + 1
        for: 1 <= i <= n
            for: i + 1 <= j <= n
                if directed[i - 1][j - 1] > 0 or directed[j - 1][i - 1] > 0
                    index := int(#edges) + 1
                    edges = edges.append([i, j])
                    length2 = length2.append(predicates.d2(points[i - 1], points[j - 1]))
                    edge_index[i - 1][j - 1] = index
                    edge_index[j - 1][i - 1] = index
        start := n + 1
        for edge := mesh.hull_edges()[]
            hull_next[edge[0] - 1] = edge[1]
            hull_prev[edge[1] - 1] = edge[0]
            if edge[0] < start
                start = edge[0]
        hull = [start]
        while hull_next[hull[-1] - 1] != start
            hull = hull.append(hull_next[hull[-1] - 1])
        for: i < int(#hull)
            u := hull[i]
            v := hull[(i + 1) % int(#hull)]
            hull_edges = hull_edges.append([u, v])
            hull_perimeter += proximity.root(predicates.d2(points[u - 1], points[v - 1]))
            hull_area2 += points[u - 1][0] * points[v - 1][1] - points[v - 1][0] * points[u - 1][1]
        int[][] adjacent := [for point := points[] then []]
        for edge := edges[]
            adjacent[edge[0] - 1] = adjacent[edge[0] - 1].append(edge[1])
            adjacent[edge[1] - 1] = adjacent[edge[1] - 1].append(edge[0])
        for: 1 <= site <= n
            order := voronoi.neighbor_order(site, adjacent[site - 1], directed, hull_next)
            neighbors = neighbors.append(order)
            degree = degree.append(int(#order))

    void .analyze_triangles()
        for: k < int(#triangles)
            triangle := triangles[k]
            a := points[triangle[0] - 1]
            b := points[triangle[1] - 1]
            c := points[triangle[2] - 1]
            area := predicates.orient(a, b, c)
            products := [predicates.dot(a, b, c), predicates.dot(b, c, a), predicates.dot(c, a, b)]
            lengths := [predicates.d2(b, c), predicates.d2(c, a), predicates.d2(a, b)]
            kind := 0
            if products[0] == 0 or products[1] == 0 or products[2] == 0
                kind = 1
            elif products[0] < 0 or products[1] < 0 or products[2] < 0
                kind = 2
            names := ["acute", "right", "obtuse"]
            kinds = kinds.append(names[kind])
            kind_counts[kind] += 1
            shortest := 0
            longest := 0
            for: 1 <= i < 3
                if lengths[i] < lengths[shortest]
                    shortest = i
                if lengths[i] > lengths[longest]
                    longest = i
            minimum := angle2(as_real(area), as_real(products[shortest])) * 180.0 / 3.141592653589793
            maximum := angle2(as_real(area), as_real(products[longest])) * 180.0 / 3.141592653589793
            area2 = area2.append(area)
            min_angles = min_angles.append(minimum)
            max_angles = max_angles.append(maximum)
            bin_index := 0
            while minimum >= as_real((bin_index + 1) * 10)
                bin_index += 1
            angle_bins[bin_index] += 1
            min_angle_total += minimum
            if minimum_triangle == 0 or minimum < min_angles[minimum_triangle - 1]
                minimum_triangle = k + 1
            if maximum_triangle == 0 or maximum > max_angles[maximum_triangle - 1]
                maximum_triangle = k + 1

    void .analyze_voronoi()
        for: k < int(#triangles)
            triangle := triangles[k]
            a := points[triangle[0] - 1]
            b := points[triangle[1] - 1]
            c := points[triangle[2] - 1]
            center := predicates.center(a, b, c)
            position := voronoi.position(center, points, hull)
            centers = centers.append(center)
            radius2 = radius2.append(voronoi.radius2(a, b, c))
            positions = positions.append(position)
            index := if position == "inside" then 0 elif position == "on" then 1 else 2
            position_counts[index] += 1
            if position == "inside"
                empty_candidates = empty_candidates.append(k + 1)
                if empty_vertex == 0 or radius2[k] > radius2[empty_vertex - 1]
                    empty_vertex = k + 1
        for edge := edges[]
            left := edge_triangles[edge[0] - 1][edge[1] - 1]
            right := edge_triangles[edge[1] - 1][edge[0] - 1]
            if left > 0 and right > 0
                duals = duals.append("segment {left} {right}")
            else
                u := if left > 0 then edge[0] else edge[1]
                v := if left > 0 then edge[1] else edge[0]
                number := if left > 0 then left else right
                duals = duals.append("ray {number} {words(voronoi.outward(points, u, v))}")
        for: 1 <= site <= n
            int[] vertices := []
            int[][] cell_centers := []
            for other := neighbors[site - 1][]
                number := edge_triangles[site - 1][other - 1]
                if number > 0
                    vertices = vertices.append(number)
                    cell_centers = cell_centers.append(centers[number - 1])
            clipped := voronoi.clipped_area(points, site, neighbors[site - 1])
            bounded := hull_next[site - 1] == 0
            real64 area := 0.0
            int[] incoming := []
            int[] outgoing := []
            if bounded
                area = voronoi.bounded_area(points[site - 1], cell_centers)
                cell_total += area
                if largest_cell == 0 or area > cells[largest_cell - 1].area
                    largest_cell = site
            else
                incoming = voronoi.outward(points, site, hull_next[site - 1])
                outgoing = voronoi.outward(points, hull_prev[site - 1], site)
            clip_total += clipped
            cells = cells.append(Cell(vertices, clipped, bounded, area, incoming, outgoing))

    void .analyze_proximity()
        nearest_sites = proximity.nearest(points, neighbors)
        for: 1 <= site <= n
            other := nearest_sites[site - 1]
            if site < other and nearest_sites[other - 1] == site
                mutual_pairs = mutual_pairs.append([site, other])
        closest = 1
        for: 1 <= i < int(#edges)
            if length2[i] < length2[closest - 1]
                closest = i + 1
        components = proximity.components(nearest_sites)
        for: k < int(#components)
            int[] pair := []
            for site := components[k][]
                component_number[site - 1] = k + 1
                other := nearest_sites[site - 1]
                if site < other and nearest_sites[other - 1] == site
                    pair = [site, other]
            component_pairs = component_pairs.append(pair)
        mst = proximity.kruskal(points, edges)
        mst_set = array(#edges, fill = false)
        gabriel = array(#edges, fill = false)
        rng = array(#edges, fill = false)
        for edge := mst[]
            i := edge[0] - 1
            j := edge[1] - 1
            mst_set[edge_index[i][j] - 1] = true
            mst_length += proximity.root(predicates.d2(points[i], points[j]))
            mst_degree[i] += 1
            mst_degree[j] += 1
        for: k < int(#edges)
            edge := edges[k]
            if proximity.gabriel(points, edge, directed)
                gabriel[k] = true
                gabriel_count += 1
                gg_degree[edge[0] - 1] += 1
                gg_degree[edge[1] - 1] += 1
            if proximity.relative(points, edge)
                rng[k] = true
                rng_count += 1
                rng_degree[edge[0] - 1] += 1
                rng_degree[edge[1] - 1] += 1

    void .enclosing_circle()
        int[] basis := []
        for: i < int(#hull)
            site := hull[i]
            if #basis == 0 or circle_value(points, basis, points[site - 1]) < 0
                basis = [site]
                for: j < i
                    second := hull[j]
                    if circle_value(points, basis, points[second - 1]) < 0
                        basis = [site, second]
                        for: k < j
                            third := hull[k]
                            if circle_value(points, basis, points[third - 1]) < 0
                                basis = circle_basis(points, [site, second, third])
        int[] boundary := []
        for: 1 <= site <= n
            if circle_value(points, basis, points[site - 1]) == 0
                boundary = boundary.append(site)
        int[] diameter_pair := []
        for: i < int(#boundary) - 1
            for: i + 1 <= j < int(#boundary)
                a := boundary[i]
                b := boundary[j]
                valid := true
                for other := boundary[]
                    if predicates.dot(points[other - 1], points[a - 1], points[b - 1]) != 0
                        valid = false
                if valid
                    diameter_pair = [a, b]
                    break
            if #diameter_pair > 0
                break
        if #diameter_pair > 0
            a := points[diameter_pair[0] - 1]
            b := points[diameter_pair[1] - 1]
            enclosing_center = [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], 2]
            enclosing_radius2 = as_real(predicates.d2(a, b)) / 4.0
        else
            ordered := circle_basis(points, boundary)
            a := points[ordered[0] - 1]
            b := points[ordered[1] - 1]
            c := points[ordered[2] - 1]
            enclosing_center = predicates.center(a, b, c)
            enclosing_radius2 = voronoi.radius2(a, b, c)
        enclosing_sites = boundary

    void .analyze_extent()
        diameter2 = predicates.d2(points[0], points[1])
        for: 1 <= i <= n
            for: i + 1 <= j <= n
                value := predicates.d2(points[i - 1], points[j - 1])
                if value > diameter2
                    diameter = [i, j]
                    diameter2 = value
        for edge := hull_edges[]
            a := points[edge[0] - 1]
            b := points[edge[1] - 1]
            maximum := 0
            for site := hull[]
                value := predicates.orient(a, b, points[site - 1])
                if value > maximum
                    maximum = value
            width := as_real(maximum) / proximity.root(predicates.d2(a, b))
            if width < width_value
                width_value = width
                width_edge = edge
        .self.enclosing_circle()

    void .analyze_layers()
        remaining := 1:n
        while #remaining != 0
            layer := convex_hull(points, remaining)
            layers = layers.append(layer)
            removed := array(nat(n), fill = false)
            for site := layer[]
                depth[site - 1] = int(#layers)
                removed[site - 1] = true
            remaining = [for site := remaining[] if not removed[site - 1] then site]

    proximity.Shortest .shortest_from(int site)
        if #path_distances[site - 1] == 0
            path := proximity.dijkstra(points, neighbors, site)
            path_distances[site - 1] = path.distances
            path_previous[site - 1] = path.previous
        return proximity.Shortest(path_distances[site - 1], path_previous[site - 1])

    void .analyze_spanner()
        pair_count = n * (n - 1) / 2
        real64 total := 0.0
        for: 1 <= i < n
            proximity.Shortest path := .self.shortest_from(i)
            for: i + 1 <= j <= n
                length := path.distances[j - 1]
                distance := proximity.root(predicates.d2(points[i - 1], points[j - 1]))
                stretch := length / distance
                total += stretch
                if #stretch_pair == 0 or stretch > maximum_stretch
                    maximum_stretch = stretch
                    stretch_pair = [i, j]
                    stretch_length = length
                    stretch_distance = distance
        mean_stretch = total / as_real(pair_count)

    void .analyze_alpha()
        for alpha := params.alpha[]
            faces := 0
            total_area := 0
            incidence := array(#edges, fill = 0)
            selected := array(#edges, fill = false)
            for: k < int(#triangles)
                if radius2[k] <= as_real(alpha)
                    faces += 1
                    total_area += area2[k]
                    triangle := triangles[k]
                    for: side < 3
                        index := edge_index[triangle[side] - 1][triangle[(side + 1) % 3] - 1] - 1
                        incidence[index] += 1
                        selected[index] = true
            for: k < int(#edges)
                if gabriel[k] and length2[k] <= 4 * alpha
                    selected[k] = true
            sets := proximity.new_sets(n)
            incident := array(nat(n), fill = false)
            selected_edges := 0
            boundary := 0
            dangling := 0
            isolated := 0
            for: k < int(#edges)
                if selected[k]
                    selected_edges += 1
                    if incidence[k] == 1
                        boundary += 1
                    if incidence[k] == 0
                        dangling += 1
                    edge := edges[k]
                    .sets.join(edge[0], edge[1])
                    incident[edge[0] - 1] = true
                    incident[edge[1] - 1] = true
            for value := incident[]
                if not value
                    isolated += 1
            alpha_results = alpha_results.append(AlphaResult(alpha, faces, selected_edges, boundary, dangling, isolated, sets.count, sets.count - (n - selected_edges + faces), total_area))

    string locate(int[] query)
        nearest := 1
        best := predicates.d2(points[0], query)
        for: 1 <= site < n
            distance := predicates.d2(points[site], query)
            if distance < best
                nearest = site + 1
                best = distance
        location := "outside"
        if best == 0
            location = "vertex {nearest}"
        else
            for edge := edges[]
                a := points[edge[0] - 1]
                b := points[edge[1] - 1]
                if predicates.orient(a, b, query) == 0 and predicates.dot(query, a, b) < 0
                    location = "edge {words(edge)}"
                    break
            if location == "outside"
                for triangle := triangles[]
                    a := points[triangle[0] - 1]
                    b := points[triangle[1] - 1]
                    c := points[triangle[2] - 1]
                    if predicates.orient(a, b, query) > 0 and predicates.orient(b, c, query) > 0 and predicates.orient(c, a, query) > 0
                        location = "triangle {words(triangle)}"
                        break
        return "{location} nearest {nearest} d2 {best}"

    string .answer(string query)
        fields := query.split(" ")
        name := fields[0]
        values := [for value := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then integer_value(value)]
        if name == "route" or name == "path" or name == "neighbors" or name == "edge"
            for site := values[]
                if site < 1 or site > n
                    return "{query} error unknown_site"
            if name == "edge" and values[0] == values[1]
                return "{query} error same_site"
        result := ""
        if name == "locate"
            result = locate(values)
        elif name == "walk"
            walk := mesh.visibility_walk(values, triangles, edge_triangles)
            stopping := if #walk.outside > 0 then "outside {words(walk.outside)}" else "triangle {walk.path[-1]}"
            result = "steps {int(#walk.path) - 1} {stopping} path {words(walk.path)}"
        elif name == "natural"
            count := 0
            present := array(nat(n), fill = false)
            for triangle := triangles[]
                if predicates.incircle(points[triangle[0] - 1], points[triangle[1] - 1], points[triangle[2] - 1], values) > 0
                    count += 1
                    for site := triangle[]
                        present[site - 1] = true
            sites := [for site := (1:n)[] if present[site - 1] then site]
            sequence := if #sites == 0 then "-" else words(sites)
            result = "triangles {count} sites {sequence}"
        elif name == "route"
            route := proximity.greedy_route(points, neighbors, values[0], values[1])
            result = "hops {int(#route.path) - 1} length {real_text(route.length)} path {words(route.path)}"
        elif name == "path"
            first := values[0]
            second := values[1]
            proximity.Shortest shortest := .self.shortest_from(first)
            reverse := [second]
            while reverse[-1] != first
                reverse = reverse.append(shortest.previous[reverse[-1] - 1])
            path := reverse[::-1]
            stretch := if first == second then "-" else real_text(shortest.distances[second - 1] / proximity.root(predicates.d2(points[first - 1], points[second - 1])))
            result = "length {real_text(shortest.distances[second - 1])} stretch {stretch} hops {int(#path) - 1} sites {words(path)}"

            result = "degree {degree[values[0] - 1]} sites {words(neighbors[values[0] - 1])}"
        else
            i := values[0]
            j := values[1]
            index := edge_index[i - 1][j - 1] - 1
            if index >= 0
                result = "delaunay len2 {length2[index]} gabriel {yes_no(gabriel[index])} rng {yes_no(rng[index])} mst {yes_no(mst_set[index])} dual {duals[index]}"

                string[] crossings := []

                for edge := edges[]

                    q := points[edge[1] - 1]

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

class Canvas self(int width, int height)
    string[][] rows := [for r := (0:<height)[] then array(nat(width), fill = " ")]

    int[] position(int[] point)
        d := if #point == 3 then point[2] else 1
        column := (2 * point[0] * (width - 1) + 1000 * d) / (2000 * d)
        row := height - 1 - (2 * point[1] * (height - 1) + 1000 * d) / (2000 * d)
        return [column, row]

    void .mark(int[] point, string character)
        cell := position(point)
        rows[cell[1]][cell[0]] = character

    void .line(int[] first, int[] second, string character)
        start := position(first)
        finish := position(second)
        x := start[0]
        y := start[1]
        dx := absolute(finish[0] - x)
        dy := -absolute(finish[1] - y)
        sx := if x < finish[0] then 1 else -1
        sy := if y < finish[1] then 1 else -1
        error_value := dx + dy
        while true
            rows[y][x] = character
            if x == finish[0] and y == finish[1]
                return
            twice := 2 * error_value
            if twice >= dy
                error_value += dy
                x += sx
            if twice <= dx
                error_value += dx
                y += sy

    void .draw_voronoi(int[][] points)
        horizontal := width - 1
        vertical := height - 1
        int[][] owners := []
        for: r < height
            int[] owner_row := []
            for: c < width
                owner := 0
                best := 0
                for: site < int(#points)
                    dx := (c * 1000 - points[site][0] * horizontal) * vertical
                    dy := ((vertical - r) * 1000 - points[site][1] * vertical) * horizontal
                    distance := dx * dx + dy * dy
                    if owner == 0 or distance < best
                        owner = site + 1
                        best = distance
                owner_row = owner_row.append(owner)
            owners = owners.append(owner_row)
        for: r < height
            for: c < width
                owner := owners[r][c]
                if c < horizontal and owner != owners[r][c + 1] or r < vertical and owner != owners[r + 1][c]
                    rows[r][c] = "#"
        for point := points[]
            .self.mark(point, "o")

    string[] framed()
        border := "+" + "-" * nat(width) + "+"
        result := [border]
        for row := rows[]
            result = result.append("|" + row.join("") + "|")
        return result.append(border)

int orient(int[] p, int[] q, int[] r)
    return (q[0] - p[0]) * (r[1] - p[1]) - (q[1] - p[1]) * (r[0] - p[0])

int d2(int[] p, int[] q)
    x := p[0] - q[0]
    y := p[1] - q[1]
    return x * x + y * y

int dot(int[] o, int[] p, int[] q)
    return (p[0] - o[0]) * (q[0] - o[0]) + (p[1] - o[1]) * (q[1] - o[1])

int incircle(int[] a, int[] b, int[] c, int[] d)
    ax := a[0] - d[0]
    ay := a[1] - d[1]
    bx := b[0] - d[0]
    by := b[1] - d[1]
    cx := c[0] - d[0]
    cy := c[1] - d[1]
    aa := ax * ax + ay * ay
    bb := bx * bx + by * by
    cc := cx * cx + cy * cy
    return ax * (by * cc - bb * cy) - ay * (bx * cc - bb * cx) + aa * (bx * cy - by * cx)

int[] center(int[] a, int[] b, int[] c)
    bx := b[0] - a[0]
    by := b[1] - a[1]
    cx := c[0] - a[0]
    cy := c[1] - a[1]
    bb := bx * bx + by * by
    cc := cx * cx + cy * cy
    d := 2 * (bx * cy - by * cx)
    return [a[0] * d + cy * bb - by * cc, a[1] * d + bx * cc - cx * bb, d]

int gcd(int first, int second)
    first = if first < 0 then -first else first
    second = if second < 0 then -second else second
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return first

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    common := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    numerator /= common
    denominator /= common
    return if denominator == 1 then "{numerator}" else "{numerator}/{denominator}"

int[] direction(int x, int y)
    common := gcd(x, y)
    return [x / common, y / common]

import math

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

real64 root(int value)
    result := math.sqrt(as_real(value))
    return result

class DisjointSets self(int[] parent, int[] sizes, int count)
    int .find(int site)
        while parent[site - 1] != site
            parent[site - 1] = parent[parent[site - 1] - 1]
            site = parent[site - 1]
        return site

    bool .join(int first, int second)
        first = .self.find(first)
        second = .self.find(second)
        if first == second
            return false
        if sizes[first - 1] < sizes[second - 1]
            temporary := first
            first = second
            second = temporary
        parent[second - 1] = first
        sizes[first - 1] += sizes[second - 1]
        count -= 1
        return true

DisjointSets new_sets(int count)
    return DisjointSets(1:count, array(nat(count), fill = 1), count)

int[] nearest(int[][] points, int[][] neighbors)
    int[] result := []
    for: site < int(#points)
        best := neighbors[site][0]
        distance := predicates.d2(points[site], points[best - 1])
        for other := neighbors[site][]
            value := predicates.d2(points[site], points[other - 1])
            if value < distance or value == distance and other < best
                best = other
                distance = value
        result = result.append(best)
    return result

int[][] components(int[] nearest_sites)
    sets := new_sets(int(#nearest_sites))
    for: i < int(#nearest_sites)
        .sets.join(i + 1, nearest_sites[i])
    int[] roots := []
    int[][] groups := []
    for: 1 <= site <= int(#nearest_sites)
        representative := .sets.find(site)
        index := -1
        for: k < int(#roots)
            if roots[k] == representative
                index = k
                break
        if index < 0
            index = int(#roots)
            roots = roots.append(representative)
            groups = groups.append([])
        groups[index] = groups[index].append(site)
    return groups

int[][] kruskal(int[][] points, int[][] edges)
    int[] ordered := []
    for: i < int(#edges)
        distance := predicates.d2(points[edges[i][0] - 1], points[edges[i][1] - 1])
        place := int(#ordered)
        for: k < int(#ordered)
            other := ordered[k]
            if distance < predicates.d2(points[edges[other][0] - 1], points[edges[other][1] - 1])
                place = k
                break
        ordered = ordered[0:<place].append(i).concat(ordered[place:<int(#ordered)])
    sets := new_sets(int(#points))
    int[][] result := []
    for index := ordered[]
        edge := edges[index]
        if .sets.join(edge[0], edge[1])
            result = result.append(edge)
            if sets.count == 1
                break
    return result

bool gabriel(int[][] points, int[] edge, int[][] directed)
    first := edge[0]
    second := edge[1]
    left := directed[first - 1][second - 1]
    right := directed[second - 1][first - 1]
    return (left == 0 or predicates.dot(points[left - 1], points[first - 1], points[second - 1]) > 0) and (right == 0 or predicates.dot(points[right - 1], points[first - 1], points[second - 1]) > 0)

bool relative(int[][] points, int[] edge)
    first := points[edge[0] - 1]
    second := points[edge[1] - 1]
    distance := predicates.d2(first, second)
    for point := points[]
        if predicates.d2(first, point) < distance and predicates.d2(second, point) < distance
            return false
    return true

class Route(int[] path, real64 length)
class Shortest(real64[] distances, int[] previous)

Route greedy_route(int[][] points, int[][] neighbors, int start, int target)
    path := [start]
    real64 length := 0.0
    current := start
    while current != target
        following := neighbors[current - 1][0]
        best := predicates.d2(points[following - 1], points[target - 1])
        for site := neighbors[current - 1][]
            value := predicates.d2(points[site - 1], points[target - 1])
            if value < best or value == best and site < following
                following = site
                best = value
        length += root(predicates.d2(points[current - 1], points[following - 1]))
        path = path.append(following)
        current = following
    return Route(path, length)

Shortest dijkstra(int[][] points, int[][] neighbors, int start)
    real64[] distances := array(#points, fill = inf)
    previous := array(#points, fill = 0)
    visited := array(#points, fill = false)
    distances[start - 1] = 0.0
    for _ < int(#points)
        current := -1
        for: site < int(#points)
            if not visited[site] and (current < 0 or distances[site] < distances[current])
                current = site
        if current < 0
            break
        visited[current] = true
        for other := neighbors[current][]
            candidate := distances[current] + root(predicates.d2(points[current], points[other - 1]))
            if candidate < distances[other - 1]
                distances[other - 1] = candidate
                previous[other - 1] = current + 1
    return Shortest(distances, previous)

class Mesh self(int[][] points, map<int, int> directed, int[] initial)
    int edge_key(int a, int b)
        return (a - 1) * int(#points) + b - 1

    int remaining(int a, int b)
        match directed.get(edge_key(a, b))
            int value
                return value
            none
                return 0

    void .add_triangle(int a, int b, int c)
        .directed.set(edge_key(a, b), c)
        .directed.set(edge_key(b, c), a)
        .directed.set(edge_key(c, a), b)

    void .remove_triangle(int a, int b, int c)
        .directed.remove(edge_key(a, b))
        .directed.remove(edge_key(b, c))
        .directed.remove(edge_key(c, a))

    int[][] triangles()
        int[][] result := []
        for key := directed.keys().sorted()[]
            a := key / int(#points) + 1
            b := key % int(#points) + 1
            int c := remaining(a, b)
            if a < b and a < c
                result = result.append([a, b, c])
        return result

    int[][] hull_edges()
        int[][] result := []
        for key := directed.keys().sorted()[]
            a := key / int(#points) + 1
            b := key % int(#points) + 1
            if remaining(b, a) == 0
                result = result.append([a, b])
        return result

    Insertion .insert(int site)
        int[] containing := []
        for triangle := triangles()[]
            int a := triangle[0]
            int b := triangle[1]
            int c := triangle[2]
            if predicates.orient(points[a - 1], points[b - 1], points[site - 1]) > 0 and predicates.orient(points[b - 1], points[c - 1], points[site - 1]) > 0 and predicates.orient(points[c - 1], points[a - 1], points[site - 1]) > 0
                containing = triangle
                break
        int[][] check := []
        visible := 0
        if #containing > 0
            a := containing[0]
            b := containing[1]
            c := containing[2]
            .self.remove_triangle(a, b, c)
            check = [[a, b], [b, c], [c, a]]
        else
            for edge := hull_edges()[]
                if predicates.orient(points[edge[0] - 1], points[edge[1] - 1], points[site - 1]) < 0
                    check = check.append([edge[1], edge[0]])
            visible = int(#check)
        distinct<int> pending
        int[] stack := []
        for edge := check[]
            .self.add_triangle(edge[0], edge[1], site)
            push_pending(&pending, &stack, edge_key(edge[0], edge[1]))
        flips := 0
        while #stack != 0
            key := stack[-1]
            stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
            .pending.remove(key)
            a := key / int(#points) + 1
            b := key % int(#points) + 1
            int q := remaining(b, a)
            if remaining(a, b) == site and q > 0 and predicates.incircle(points[a - 1], points[b - 1], points[site - 1], points[q - 1]) > 0
                .self.remove_triangle(a, b, site)
                .self.remove_triangle(b, a, q)
                .self.add_triangle(a, q, site)
                .self.add_triangle(q, b, site)
                push_pending(&pending, &stack, edge_key(a, q))
                push_pending(&pending, &stack, edge_key(q, b))
                flips += 1
        return Insertion(if #containing > 0 then "inside" else "outside", containing, visible, flips, int(directed.size()) / 3, int(#hull_edges()))

    Walk visibility_walk(int[] query, int[][] numbered, int[][] edge_triangles)
        path := [1]
        while true
            triangle := numbered[path[-1] - 1]
            int[][] edges := [[triangle[0], triangle[1]], [triangle[1], triangle[2]], [triangle[2], triangle[0]]]
            int[] crossing := []
            for edge := edges[]
                if predicates.orient(points[edge[0] - 1], points[edge[1] - 1], query) < 0
                    crossing = edge
                    break
            if #crossing == 0
                return Walk(path, [])
            following := edge_triangles[crossing[1] - 1][crossing[0] - 1]
            if following == 0
                return Walk(path, crossing.sorted())
            path = path.append(following)
        return Walk(path, [])

Mesh new_mesh(int[][] points)
    int[] initial := if predicates.orient(points[0], points[1], points[2]) > 0 then [1, 2, 3] else [1, 3, 2]
    map<int, int> directed
    result := Mesh(points, directed, initial)
    .result.add_triangle(initial[0], initial[1], initial[2])
    return result

import predicates = "./predicates.qui"
import math

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

real64 root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

real64 radius2(int[] a, int[] b, int[] c)
    first := as_real(predicates.d2(a, b))
    second := as_real(predicates.d2(b, c))
    third := as_real(predicates.d2(c, a))
    area := as_real(predicates.orient(a, b, c))
    return ((first * second) * third) / ((4.0 * area) * area)

string position(int[] center, int[][] points, int[] hull)
    on := false
    for: i < int(#hull)
        p := points[hull[i] - 1]
        q := points[hull[(i + 1) % int(#hull)] - 1]
        sigma := (q[0] - p[0]) * (center[1] - p[1] * center[2]) - (q[1] - p[1]) * (center[0] - p[0] * center[2])
        if sigma < 0
            return "outside"
        if sigma == 0
            on = true
    return if on then "on" else "inside"

int[] neighbor_order(int site, int[] adjacent, int[][] directed, int[] following)
    first := if following[site - 1] > 0 then following[site - 1] else adjacent.sorted()[0]
    result := [first]
    while #result < #adjacent
        result = result.append(directed[site - 1][result[-1] - 1])
    return result

int[] outward(int[][] points, int u, int v)
    return predicates.direction(points[v - 1][1] - points[u - 1][1], points[u - 1][0] - points[v - 1][0])

real64 bounded_area(int[] site, int[][] centers)
    real64[][] relative := []
    for center := centers[]
        relative = relative.append([as_real(center[0]) / as_real(center[2]) - as_real(site[0]), as_real(center[1]) / as_real(center[2]) - as_real(site[1])])
    real64 total := 0.0
    for: i < int(#relative)
        p := relative[i]
        q := relative[(i + 1) % int(#relative)]
        total += p[0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[1]
    return total / 2.0

real64 clipped_area(int[][] points, int site, int[] neighbors)
    real64[][] polygon := [[0.0, 0.0], [1000.0, 0.0], [1000.0, 1000.0], [0.0, 1000.0]]
    xs := points[site - 1][0]
    ys := points[site - 1][1]
    for neighbor := neighbors[]
        xt := points[neighbor - 1][0]
        yt := points[neighbor - 1][1]
        c1 := as_real(2 * (xt - xs))
        c2 := as_real(2 * (yt - ys))
        c3 := as_real(xt * xt + yt * yt - xs * xs - ys * ys)
        real64[][] clipped := []
        for: i < int(#polygon)
            p := polygon[i]
            q := polygon[(i + 1) % int(#polygon)]
            fp := c1 * p[0] + c2 * p[1] - c3
            fq := c1 * q[0] + c2 * q[1] - c3
            if fp <= 0.0
                clipped = clipped.append(p)
            if fp < 0.0 and fq > 0.0 or fq < 0.0 and fp > 0.0
                fraction := fp / (fp - fq)
                clipped = clipped.append([p[0] + (q[0] - p[0]) * fraction, p[1] + (q[1] - p[1]) * fraction])
        polygon = clipped
    real64 total := 0.0
    for: i < int(#polygon)
        p := polygon[i]
        q := polygon[(i + 1) % int(#polygon)]
        total += p[0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[1]
    return total / 2.0
